title: Easy shit to attack
rule: No invented FB member counts, emails, or review totals. Sizes unknown unless disk-published. Calendar free-days only from live Google Calendar — if MCP auth fails, show connect gap. GTM language matches Sell lanes: Violet · Subscription · Sponsor · Big Enterprise. Team-swingable = junior/commission can attack; founder-only = relationship/budget/org gate. Convert often includes Google/FB review ask (link on site) — do not invent review counts.

gtm_lanes.Violet: Consumer / mom / birthday / mobile — consumer-inbound + social soft invite
gtm_lanes.Sponsor: Festivals / mom media / shoutouts / barter / paid spotlight

google_review_note: Site booking-help links this share URL. Aggregators have cited review counts — do not display a live count here (not re-verified this build).
